description: Remove a cloud flow from the environment for good. Read it with cs_get_flow first: any agent tool that calls this flow will be left pointing at nothing, and a flow that is still switched on has to be turned off with cs_set_flow_state before Dataverse will delete it. A managed flow cannot be deleted this way; uninstall the solution it came in. Changes a live environment and cannot be undone: requires confirm: true.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

dataverseUrl.description: Dataverse URL; default: from the workspace or the environment

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_delete_flow
title: Delete a cloud flow
